limits: Scope convention:leading-icon only. Button alone may place its decorative icon at start or end through iconPosition, end by default. Toggle alone may render a required decorative icon as its sole visible content, with a required accessible label.
No other component gains trailing-icon or icon-only permission. Interactive icons and icons as the sole carrier of meaning remain excluded.

This record supersedes as current text, but does not erase, the Button approval (docs/components/button/v0.1/prop-naming-approval.json, contentHash sha256:6beeba4aea0a65b13367990fde8dd8439b07af12df9d8e9432c1a94b16997d4c) and the Toggle approval (docs/components/toggle/v0.1/prop-naming-approval.json, contentHash sha256:a32eb28ca98d0b726758cac132be9e68dda855b16e1bdf399944d64ea7ae91e0). Both files stay byte-identical and are pinned below.
The Toggle approval is a parallel branch from the same base; it is pinned as a historical record, not spliced into the linear receipt chain. Historical receipt bytes and hashes remain immutable.

before.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. Button alone may place this icon before or after its label, after it by default.
before.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. Button alone also permits its iconPosition start/end slot, default end.
before.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. The trailing-icon exclusion has one exception: Button with iconPosition; no other component gains trailing-icon permission.

after.meaning: Optional decorative icon rendered beside a component's text label (before it by default) and hidden from assistive technology. Button alone may place this icon before or after its label, after it by default. Toggle alone also accepts a required decorative icon as its sole visible content, with a required accessible label.
after.whenToUse: A labelled component offers a leading pictogram that repeats or decorates meaning already present in its text. Button alone also permits its iconPosition start/end slot, default end. Toggle alone permits its icon-only branch when icon and accessible label are both required.
after.avoid: Icon-only controls (their accessible name is a separate required prop), trailing or interactive icons, or the sole carrier of meaning. Two scoped exceptions apply: Button with iconPosition may place the icon after its label, and Toggle with a required icon and accessible label may render icon-only. No other component gains trailing-icon or icon-only permission, and interactive icons remain excluded.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Button (iconPosition start/end, default end) and Toggle (icon-only branch with required icon and accessible label) only. The canonical icon name, aliases, exceptions, status and existing source usages are unchanged by this amendment.
